name: Cognizant

rounds.name: GenC / GenC Next Online Test
rounds.detail: Aptitude (quant, logical, verbal) + coding for Next/Elevate tracks.

rounds.name: Technical Interview
rounds.detail: Programming basics, SQL queries, one project question, OOP concepts.

rounds.name: HR Round
rounds.detail: Flexibility, documentation, communication, willingness to learn.

aptitudePatterns.sample: The average age of a class of 30 is 15. A student aged 20 leaves. What is the new average?
Pointing to a photo, Ravi says 'her mother is my mother's only daughter'. Who is she to Ravi?
If ROSE is written as 6821, how is CHAIR written in the same code?

codingPatterns.sample: Print a pyramid of stars for n rows.
Find whether a number is an Armstrong number.
Write a query to fetch the second-highest salary from an Employee table.

hrQuestions: Why should we hire you over a candidate with better marks?
Are you comfortable with the GenC service agreement?
Which is your strongest subject and can you teach it to us in 2 minutes?
tips: GenC Next coding is 2 medium problems - clear patterns get you the higher package.
SQL joins and GROUP BY come up in almost every technical round.
Keep marksheets, ID proof and resume copies ready - the process is same-day.
